source_comparison.method: Token comparisons preserve string contents, ignoring comments/whitespace and optional trailing commas. Normalize new module facades, narrowed field scopes, explicit source borrows and pure generation helper calls at their original positions. Review aid, not formal refinement.

Queue-wide consumption remains shared; no new per-waiter progress/fairness guarantee or Sitas backstop removal.
Captured source retains no ring backing, root lease, result observation or physical quiescence authority.
Payload/source/containing destructor and outer IRQ/guard contexts remain separately qualified or open.
No model change or attribution of historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping failures.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
